result_text:
I changed the two mock-folder rules in `codeanalyzer/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/scoping/ScopingConventions.java` (lines 393–394). I haven't tested the new regexes against any of your example paths. The `mvn` test run printed nothing, and I didn't check whether any matching tests exist.

- **Before:** the rules were `.*/__mock[a-zA-Z0-9_\- ]+/.*` and `.*/mock[a-zA-Z0-9_\- ]+/.*`. The `+` required at least one extra character after `mock`, and the character class allowed only ASCII letters, digits, `_`, `-` and space.
- **After:** they are `.*/__mock[^/\\]*/.*` and `.*/mock[^/\\]*/.*`. Any folder whose name starts with `mock` or `__mock` now matches, whatever follows. That covers plain `mock`, `mock.data`, `mock(old)`, `mock-größe` and `mock模拟`. The old matches (`mocks/`, `__mocks__/`, `mock-data/`, `mock_data/`, `mock data/`, `mockStore/`) still match.

By reading the regexes and the existing path matching (not by running them), these should hold:
- **Single folder name:** the folder name can't contain `/` or `\`, so the match stays inside one folder name. A folder like `remock/` or `demo/`, `src/main/java/`, and files named `mock.java` or `mockery.java` don't match. The rule needs `/mock…/` with a following slash.
- **Windows paths:** `SourceFileFilter.pathMatches` already retries with backslashes turned into `/`, so Windows-style paths work with no further change.
